stemMd: How many integers n satisfy 40<n≤73 and are divisible by 6?
explanationMd: The multiples are 42,48,54,60,66,72. There are six. Alternatively, floor(73/6) minus floor(40/6) is 12−6=6.

distractorRationale.c: This includes a multiple outside the interval.
distractorRationale.a: This misses one of the multiples in the interval.
distractorRationale.e: This uses the largest quotient rather than subtracting the lower range.
